title: ACR Helper: a Google Meet™ add-on for a committee deciding on one applicant at a time
body: This video shows the whole workflow with two people in one call, on a spreadsheet of made-up applicants labeled TEST.
Scopes requested: openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile, and drive.file. No spreadsheet data is sent to any server.

title: The chair has the spreadsheet. The second participant was never given access.
body: The chair has already chosen the TEST spreadsheet and starts the review.
The second participant joins the running activity. The spreadsheet is not shared with them, so the add-on must let them get access during the session.

kicker: 1 · Sign in: one button, one Google window
title: Sign in with Google: each participant chooses their own account
body: When the browser holds several Google accounts, Google's account chooser appears in each Meet tab, so every panel signs in as the person in the call.
openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile: sign the person in and show their name to the committee. drive.file: see and change only the files the person chooses for ACR Helper.

title: The picker lists only spreadsheets shared with the person
body: Google's file picker opens by itself in the side panel. It has nothing to show, because the spreadsheet is not shared with this participant yet.
The panel says so and offers Ask the chair for access. The main stage says who is running the review.

title: The chair sees the request and presses Share
body: The request reaches the chair's side panel within the call. Share gives the participant view access to that one spreadsheet, using the chair's own permission on the file they chose (drive.file).
Not now declines. No one is added without the chair pressing Share.

title: The participant's picker opens by itself, now listing the spreadsheet
body: They select it once, and the add-on opens the review on the applicant the chair is showing.

title: Private votes, revealed together
body: Each member votes in their own panel; no one sees a choice until the chair presses Reveal.

title: The chair records the decision; a note is added
body: Record writes the committee's decision into that applicant's row, with a cell note naming who recorded it and when.
Add note appends a line to the row's notes cell. Nothing else is changed.

title: What ACR Helper changed, in the one file it can open
body: The decision and its note in the applicant's row, and the participant now listed as a viewer in the spreadsheet's sharing.

title: Everyone in the call can take part, with the spreadsheet's own sharing deciding access
list: openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile: sign-in, and each member's name
drive.file: read the chosen spreadsheet; write the decision and a note; share it with a participant when the chair presses Share
No other file or Google data is opened
